title: The same order inside its window
description: The twin of case 67: the same packs with the clock pack of day 2 in place of the pack of day 6. The approval counts until day 3, so on day 2 it is believed and the order ships. The two cases differ in their clock pack alone: a clock that published no window would fail this one, a clock that never closed one would fail case 67. This is the first tick of the walk order of the sequence clock.
